title: Gideon Defeats Midian

questions.question: How many men were originally with Gideon?
questions.explanation: Judges 7:3 (ESV): "...And 22,000 of the people returned, and 10,000 remained." (Total 32,000).

questions.question: Why did God want to reduce the number of men?
options: Lest Israel boast over me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me’
To make it a fair fight
questions.correctAnswer: Lest Israel boast over me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me’
questions.explanation: Judges 7:2 (ESV): "...lest Israel boast over me, saying, 'My own hand has saved me.'"

questions.question: How many men finally went to battle with Gideon?
questions.explanation: Judges 7:7 (ESV): "And the LORD said to Gideon, ‘With the 300 men who lapped I will save you...’"

questions.question: What did the men hold in their hands?
options: Trumpets and empty jars with torches inside
questions.correctAnswer: Trumpets and empty jars with torches inside
questions.explanation: Judges 7:16 (ESV): "...and put trumpets into the hands of all of them and empty jars, with torches inside the jars."

questions.question: What was the battle cry?
options: A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!
questions.correctAnswer: A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!
questions.explanation: Judges 7:20 (ESV): "...and they cried out, 'A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!'"

questions.question: Where did the camp of Midian lie?
options: North of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley
questions.correctAnswer: North of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley
questions.explanation: Judges 7:1 (ESV): "...And the camp of Midian was north of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley."

questions.question: What test did God use at the water?
options: How they drank water (lapping vs kneeling)
questions.correctAnswer: How they drank water (lapping vs kneeling)
questions.explanation: Judges 7:5 (ESV): "...Every one who laps the water with his tongue... you shall set by himself. Likewise every one who kneels down to drink."

questions.question: Who went down to the camp with Gideon to spy?
questions.explanation: Judges 7:10-11 (ESV): "...then go down with Purah your servant to the camp..."

questions.question: What dream did the Midianite command tell his comrade?
options: A cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp and struck the tent
questions.correctAnswer: A cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp and struck the tent
questions.explanation: Judges 7:13 (ESV): "...behold, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian and came to the tent and struck it..."

questions.question: Who captured Oreb and Zeeb?
questions.explanation: Judges 7:24-25 (ESV): "...And they captured the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb..." (Context: Gideon called Ephraim).

questions.question: Where was Oreb killed?
questions.explanation: Judges 7:25 (ESV): "They killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb..."

questions.question: Where was Zeeb killed?
questions.explanation: Judges 7:25 (ESV): "...and Zeeb they killed at the winepress of Zeeb..."

questions.question: How were the Midianites and Amalekites described in number?
options: Like the sand on the seashore
questions.explanation: Judges 7:12 (ESV): "...lay along the valley like locusts in abundance..."

questions.question: At what time did Gideon and the 100 men with him reach the outskirts of the camp?
options: At the beginning of the middle watch
questions.correctAnswer: At the beginning of the middle watch
questions.explanation: Judges 7:19 (ESV): "...came to the outskirts of the camp at the beginning of the middle watch..."

questions.question: What did the Lord do to the camp of Midian essentially?
options: Set every man's sword against his comrade
questions.correctAnswer: Set every man's sword against his comrade
questions.explanation: Judges 7:22 (ESV): "...the LORD set every man's sword against his comrade and against all the army."

key_verse_text: The LORD said to Gideon, “The people with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand, lest Israel boast over me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’” (ESV)
